{{Top|leg}}
The '''stun ray''' was a non-lethal [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-mounted weapon produced by [[Quellegh Industrial]]. This publicly traded device had been known to be aggressively marketed towards any despot with [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 1 to be able to equip this item.
